summary: Plan rewritten against slice 07's authoritative contract: kind 'product'|'service' drives one Produtos & Serviços screen with a segmented filter and per-kind columns; the Preco em aberto switch and the providers editor are removed; the dialog edits slice 07's six flat default columns plus a discriminated funcao-cost editor (valuePct percent / valueBrl cents); adds productFuncaoCosts to bootstrap, hooks select and SaveProductPayload; 2 new test files and 22 enumerated fallout items including 11 bootstrap literals.
